scientific_integrity: All-order argument given in RESULT.md; finite enumeration supplements it. Standard group homology and join topology are credited, literature search does not establish priority definitively.
scientific_limitations: Constructed finite two-distance metrics with a cyclic isometric action; disproves a universal higher-degree one-sided non-overcount extension, not all sampling-specific comparisons. Borel homology is unbounded in degree when the coefficient characteristic divides the group order. Independent audit not performed.
title: Arbitrary-degree false positives in orbit-metric Vietoris–Rips persistence under free cyclic symmetry
